Hard truncation has top k for n>0 and k² for n=0. Field nonzero and two-point properness verified; zero F and empty index ranges harmless. The corrected F2 no longer attributes skeleton vocabulary to a definition lacking it; AC edge is inherited from F1 and reconciled to manifest.
